row:
Everyday Massage for Everyday People! This channel is devoted to sharing my knowledge about massage therapy with YOU! 

Board Certified in Therapeutic Massage and Bodywork since 2009 I have developed my practice to help ease pain and relax both body and mind. Since beginning this incredible journey I have worked closely with Chiropractors, Physical Therapists, and other Medical Professionals as well as other Spa Professionals. 

Massage is for EVERYONE, the young and the aging, the active and the sedentary, the homemaker and the business professionals. I hope you enjoy the content provided and it inspires you to start your massage therapy journey.
